svg.aria-label: Webhook registration switchboard: Meta's line plugs into the PRODUCTION jack while the TEST jack stays capped; the SUBSCRIBE selector points to ON (the subscribed_apps call); message cartridges roll down the rail through the raised gate into the n8n receiver. Two URLs per trigger, a 120-second test window, one subscription per WhatsApp Business Account.
svg.text: 2 URLs · test window 120s · 1 subscription per WABA
